articles.title: The Magic Lens That Could Make Your Phone's Face ID Invisible!
articles.summary: Imagine a phone with no notch or black dot! A Boston company called Metalenz has created a super-thin camera that can hide under the screen and still unlock your phone with your face. It's like magic, but it's real science.

articles.title: Surprise Mom with These Cool Gifts (That Are Actually on Sale!)
articles.summary: Mother's Day is coming! We found real deals on gifts moms love, like a garden that grows veggies indoors, a mug that keeps coffee hot, and a Kindle for endless books. But hurry—you want it to arrive by May 10!

articles.title: Jenna Elfman Joins a Spy Show Where Stephen Fry Unlocks Criminals' Minds!
articles.summary: Jenna Elfman, from 'Dharma & Greg,' is joining a new Fox series called 'The Interrogator.' She'll play a CIA agent who has to work with Stephen Fry's quirky spy—a man who can get inside the heads of bad guys. It sounds like a funny, brainy adventure!
